host_details:
I am a vinyasa flow teacher and yogini based in Nashville.  My work and my life are based in a deep trust in the flow.

In 2004, I  co-founded Sanctuary for Yoga, Body & Spirit in Nashville where I co-direct Sanctuary's 200 and 300-hour yoga teacher training programs.   In 2013, I founded Girl Tribe Ventures - a forum for collaborations with inspiring women and creative works. As part of Girl Tribe Ventures, my partner and I purchase investment property as way for traveling yogis and like-minded people to experience Nashville in an affordable way.
